tg_boatman.text: The lake can go from glass to white horses in the time it takes to eat a Welsh cake. Wear the life jacket. It does not make you look silly. It makes you look alive.
Welsh legend puts Ceridwen in a house on this lake. She is the one who kept the cauldron that made the poet Taliesin. I would not leave my sandwiches unattended near her.

tg_learner.text: Dw i'n dysgu Cymraeg. I am learning Welsh. It is going well, if by well you mean I can order a tea and apologise for not being able to order anything else.
Everyone in Bala is lovely about it. They wait. They smile. They answer in English, and then in Welsh, and then in a slower Welsh, which I appreciate.

tg_railwayman.text: Our little steam railway runs along the shore of the lake. Four miles of it, at the speed of a good conversation.
The track was once a main line. Now it is a narrow gauge and a very lovely thing to sit on with a flask.

gate_llyn_tegid.text: The road to Bala and the coast is closed. Heritage Assessment. Director Pryce has not come back with the results.
He has been up the mountain for a good while now. I am sure it is all going very well.
